name: Coffee (Heart)Break: A Departamento Cosas Tale
source:
The time has come
(to start the workday)
You’ve worked incredibly hard, you poured your heart and soul into landing this interview. It’s finally happened, Empre S.A. has called you to join the Romance Department, and it’s time to show what you’re made of: Make everyone who crosses your path fall in love with you!

Quite the first day…
You can’t stop wondering: which department will you start romancing in? The Poetry Department? Maybe a bit too intense. The Bodybuilding Department? Ugh, too superficial, you’d get bored fast. You can’t stand the suspense any longer... You rush to open the envelope Empre S.A. left for you containing your first-day itinerary. The department you’ll be working with is... the Things Department?!

Some... special colleagues
In Coffee (Heart)Break, you’ll get to know the members of the department you’re assigned to on your first day: the "Stuff Department." They’re a truly peculiar bunch, but if you give them a chance, they’ll show you their sensitive side... and who knows what else! Have fun chatting with them, complete missions, help them do their jobs right, and most importantly: forge bonds during the coffee break.

[Translated from [url=https://insanojuicioestudios.itch.io/coffee-heartbreak-a-departamento-cosas-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
